import TransposeFollowup.MatchingPageDegree

/-! Open grid cells and their overlap under a monotone map. A common
forward/inverse Lipschitz bound gives the endpoint spans needed for the
explicit residue coloring. Endpoint coincidences create no spurious edge. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup

open Classical
set_option autoImplicit false

def InGridCell {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (i.val : ℝ) < n * x ∧ (n : ℝ) * x < i.val + 1

theorem gridCell_order {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {x y : ℝ}
    (hi : InGridCell i x) (hj : InGridCell j y) (hij : i.val < j.val) : x < y := by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n by have := i.isLt; omega)
  have hv : (i.val : ℝ) + 1 ≤ j.val := by exact_mod_cast hij
  dsimp [InGridCell] at hi hj
  nlinarith

theorem gridCell_index_mono {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {x y : ℝ}
    (hi : InGridCell i x) (hj : InGridCell j y) (hxy : x ≤ y) : i.val ≤ j.val := by
  by_contra hn
  have hyx := gridCell_order hj hi (show j.val < i.val by omega)
  linarith

theorem gridCell_distance {n : ℕ} {i : Fin n} {x y : ℝ}
    (hi : InGridCell i x) (hj : InGridCell i y) : |(n : ℝ) * x - n * y| < 1 := by
  dsimp [InGridCell] at hi hj
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith

theorem scaled_abs_bound {x y u v B : ℝ} (h : |x - y| ≤ B * |u - v|) (n : ℕ) :
    |(n : ℝ) * x - n * y| ≤ B * |(n : ℝ) * u - n * v| := by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  calc
    _ = (n : ℝ) * |x - y| := by rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hn]
    _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (B * |u - v|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hn]; ring

structure BoundedMonotoneMap (B : ℕ) where
  domain : Set ℝ
  map : ℝ → ℝ
  strictMono : StrictMonoOn map domain
  forward : ∀ x ∈ domain, ∀ y ∈ domain, |map x - map y| ≤ B * |x - y|
  backward : ∀ x ∈ domain, ∀ y ∈ domain, |x - y| ≤ B * |map x - map y|

namespace BoundedMonotoneMap

variable {B : ℕ} (F : BoundedMonotoneMap B)

def Overlap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : Prop :=
  ∃ x ∈ F.domain, InGridCell i x ∧ InGridCell j (F.map x)

theorem overlap_order {n : ℕ} {i j i' j' : Fin n}
    (h : F.Overlap i j) (h' : F.Overlap i' j') (hi : i.val < i'.val) : j.val ≤ j'.val := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxi, hxj⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyi, hyj⟩ := h'
  have hxy := gridCell_order hxi hyi hi
  exact gridCell_index_mono hxj hyj (F.strictMono hx hy hxy).le

theorem overlap_row_span {n : ℕ} {i j j' : Fin n}
    (h : F.Overlap i j) (h' : F.Overlap i j') : j.val < j'.val + (B + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxi, hxj⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyi, hyj⟩ := h'
  have hd := gridCell_distance hxi hyi
  have hs := scaled_abs_bound (F.forward x hx y hy) n
  have hb : |(n : ℝ) * F.map x - n * F.map y| ≤ B :=
    hs.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right (Nat.cast_nonneg B) hd.le)
  have hdiff := le_abs_self ((n : ℝ) * F.map x - n * F.map y)
  have hreal : (j.val : ℝ) < (j'.val : ℝ) + ((B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [InGridCell] at hxj hyj
    push_cast
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast hreal

theorem overlap_column_span {n : ℕ} {i i' j : Fin n}
    (h : F.Overlap i j) (h' : F.Overlap i' j) : i.val < i'.val + (B + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxi, hxj⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyi, hyj⟩ := h'
  have hd := gridCell_distance hxj hyj
  have hs := scaled_abs_bound (F.backward x hx y hy) n
  have hb : |(n : ℝ) * x - n * y| ≤ B :=
    hs.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right (Nat.cast_nonneg B) hd.le)
  have hdiff := le_abs_self ((n : ℝ) * x - n * y)
  have hreal : (i.val : ℝ) < (i'.val : ℝ) + ((B + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [InGridCell] at hxi hyi
    push_cast
    linarith
  exact_mod_cast hreal

end BoundedMonotoneMap
end TransposeFollowup

import TransposeFollowup.MonotoneCellOverlap

/-! A finite family of bounded monotone maps defines a simple overlap graph.
Duplicate edges are retained once and assigned the least witnessing map tag.
The graph has a fixed number of nested matching pages, independent of size.
The real overlap predicate is not yet a rational decision algorithm. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup

open Classical
set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable def overlapEdges {c B : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B) (n : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin n × Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun e => ∃ p, (F p).Overlap e.1 e.2)

theorem mem_overlapEdges {c B n : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B) (e : Fin n × Fin n) :
    e ∈ overlapEdges F n ↔ ∃ p, (F p).Overlap e.1 e.2 := by simp [overlapEdges]

noncomputable def overlapTags {c B n : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B)
    (e : Fin n × Fin n) : Finset (Fin c) := Finset.univ.filter (fun p => (F p).Overlap e.1 e.2)

theorem overlapTags_nonempty {c B n : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B)
    (e : overlapEdges F n) : (overlapTags F e.val).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (mem_overlapEdges F e.val).mp e.property
  exact ⟨p, by simpa [overlapTags] using hp⟩

noncomputable def overlapTag {c B n : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B)
    (e : overlapEdges F n) : Fin c := (overlapTags F e.val).min' (overlapTags_nonempty F e)

theorem overlapTag_spec {c B n : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B)
    (e : overlapEdges F n) : (F (overlapTag F e)).Overlap e.val.1 e.val.2 := by
  have hm := Finset.min'_mem (overlapTags F e.val) (overlapTags_nonempty F e)
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2

theorem overlapTag_le {c B n : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B)
    (e : overlapEdges F n) (p : Fin c) (hp : (F p).Overlap e.val.1 e.val.2) : overlapTag F e ≤ p := by
  exact Finset.min'_le _ _ (by simpa [overlapTags] using hp)

noncomputable def overlapColoring {c B : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B) (n : ℕ) :
    ResidueMatchingInput (overlapEdges F n) c (B + 1) where
  modulus_pos := Nat.zero_lt_succ B
  tag := overlapTag F
  ordered e f hp horder := by
    have hf := overlapTag_spec F f
    rw [← hp] at hf
    exact (F (overlapTag F e)).overlap_order (overlapTag_spec F e) hf horder
  row_span e f hp he := by
    have hf := overlapTag_spec F f
    rw [← hp, ← he] at hf
    exact (F (overlapTag F e)).overlap_row_span (overlapTag_spec F e) hf
  column_span e f hp he := by
    have hf := overlapTag_spec F f
    rw [← hp, ← he] at hf
    exact (F (overlapTag F e)).overlap_column_span (overlapTag_spec F e) hf

noncomputable def overlapGraph {c B : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B) (n : ℕ) :
    SimpleGraph (Fin (2 * n)) := OrderedBipartite.graph (overlapEdges F n)

noncomputable def overlapPages {c B : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B) (n : ℕ) :
    NestedMatchingPages (overlapGraph F n) (c * ((B + 1) * (B + 1))) :=
  (overlapColoring F n).nestedPages

theorem overlapGraph_degree_le {c B : ℕ} (F : Fin c → BoundedMonotoneMap B) (n : ℕ)
    (u : Fin (2 * n)) : (overlapGraph F n).degree u ≤ c * ((B + 1) * (B + 1)) :=
  (overlapPages F n).degree_le_pages u

end TransposeFollowup

/-! The padding generator has a quadratic-logarithmic input-size allowance.
A linear number of records may each use a linear number of bit-linear
arithmetic operations. This budget lemma does not construct those operations. -/

namespace TransposeFollowup
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem grid_size_bits (n : ℕ) : (n + 1).size ≤ Transpose.entryBits n + 2 := by
  have hn := Transpose.Tape.Impl.le_two_pow_entryBits n
  have hp : 0 < 2 ^ Transpose.entryBits n := by positivity
  apply Nat.size_le.mpr
  rw [pow_add]
  norm_num
  omega

theorem linear_repetition_budget (A B n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    n * ((n + 1) * (A + B * (n + 1).size)) ≤
      2 * (A + 3 * B) * Transpose.inputLength n := by
  have hbits := grid_size_bits n
  have hb : 1 ≤ Transpose.entryBits n := by unfold Transpose.entryBits; omega
  have hwidth : A + B * (n + 1).size ≤ (A + 3 * B) * Transpose.entryBits n := by
    calc
      _ ≤ A + B * (Transpose.entryBits n + 2) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ (A + 3 * B) * Transpose.entryBits n := by nlinarith
  have hcount : n + 1 ≤ 2 * n := by omega
  calc
    _ ≤ n * ((2 * n) * ((A + 3 * B) * Transpose.entryBits n)) := by gcongr
    _ = 2 * (A + 3 * B) * Transpose.inputLength n := by
      unfold Transpose.inputLength
      ring

end TransposeFollowup
